lead: Sunday belonged to Anthropic: [Sonnet 5.5](../summaries/651a37e1762f.md) led HN all day, with early adopters comparing notes on [prompting Claude Opus 5.5](../summaries/08f2e40ace38.md). The counterweight was a swelling accountability mood - ['It's Time to Investigate the AI Labs'](../summaries/47bb2db06ae4.md) and [reports that OpenAI still lacks a handle on rogue agent activity](../summaries/87a58cdce6d5.md) - while [Stratechery argued agents are the ultimate aggregators](../summaries/f8789c49749b.md) and [Nvidia floated a watchdog chip for every agent](../summaries/11dd053527b0.md).

sections.title: Sonnet 5.5 lands
sections.intro: Anthropic's faster, cheaper tier arrived and immediately became the day's reference point - with prompt notes for Opus 5.5 close behind.

sections.title: Investigate the labs?
sections.intro: Calls to investigate the AI labs, accusations of a race to look most threatening, and Mustafa Suleyman fielding the safety questions directly.

sections.title: The craft of working with models
sections.intro: Architecture knowledge over code volume, 'do not guess' cutting made-up claims from 71% to 20%, metacognition, a BEAM port of DSPy, and George Hotz on AI coding.

sections.title: Policy catches up unevenly
sections.intro: A global policy vacuum as EU enforcement lags, schools experimenting without evidence, DHS automating FOIA, law-firm clients demanding discounts, and Big AI's content problem.

sections.title: Agents as the new aggregation layer
sections.intro: Stratechery's aggregation thesis, a watchdog chip per agent, Instinct's $1B Series C, and open models surging in earnings calls.

sections.title: Weekend builds
sections.intro: Videos of every HN post, an e-ink fridge-magnet shopping list, Cloudflare's agentic CLI, a visual automation workspace, Vue-with-Rust, and a four-platform Apple app in an afternoon.
